title: C++ Inheritance
description: Base and derived classes, the three inheritance access modes, construction and destruction order, multiple inheritance, virtual bases and the diamond problem, and the difference between overriding and hiding.

descriptionI18n.zh-Hant: 基底類別與衍生類別、三種繼承存取方式、建構與解構順序、多重繼承、虛擬基底與菱形繼承問題，以及覆寫與隱藏的分別。

questions.prompt: With `class Dog : public Animal`, what relationship does the public inheritance express?

prompt.zh-Hant: 宣告 `class Dog : public Animal` 時，public 繼承表達的是甚麼關係？

c.zh-Hant: Dog 內含（has-a）一個 Animal 成員

d.zh-Hant: Dog 與 Animal 完全無關

explanation.zh-Hant: public 繼承建立 is-a 關係：Dog 物件可以當成 Animal 使用，指向 Dog 的 Animal* 是合法的。has-a 關係應該用成員物件表達，而不是繼承。

options.text: Dog is-a Animal
Animal is-a Dog
Dog has-a Animal member
Dog and Animal are unrelated types

questions.explanation: Public inheritance models an is-a relationship: a Dog can be used wherever an Animal is expected, and an Animal* may point to a Dog. A has-a relationship should be modelled with a member object instead.

questions.prompt: A `Derived` object is created and later destroyed. Which sequence of constructor and destructor calls is correct?

prompt.zh-Hant: 建立一個 `Derived` 物件之後再銷毀它，建構函式與解構函式的呼叫順序為何？

a.zh-Hant: 基底建構函式 → 衍生建構函式 → 衍生解構函式 → 基底解構函式

b.zh-Hant: 衍生建構函式 → 基底建構函式 → 基底解構函式 → 衍生解構函式

c.zh-Hant: 基底建構函式 → 衍生建構函式 → 基底解構函式 → 衍生解構函式

d.zh-Hant: 衍生建構函式 → 基底建構函式 → 衍生解構函式 → 基底解構函式

explanation.zh-Hant: 基底必須先完整建構，衍生類別才能使用它；銷毀時順序相反，先拆衍生再拆基底。順序永遠是「基底建構、衍生建構、衍生解構、基底解構」。

options.text: Base constructor, Derived constructor, Derived destructor, Base destructor
Derived constructor, Base constructor, Base destructor, Derived destructor
Base constructor, Derived constructor, Base destructor, Derived destructor
Derived constructor, Base constructor, Derived destructor, Base destructor

questions.explanation: The base subobject must be fully constructed before the derived body runs, so base construction comes first. Destruction reverses that order: the derived part is destroyed before the base subobject.

questions.prompt: What does `class D : private B` mean for the members that `B` declares public or protected?

prompt.zh-Hant: 宣告 `class D : private B` 時，`B` 的 public 與 protected 成員在 `D` 中會變成怎樣？

a.zh-Hant: 它們在 D 中變成 private，因此 D 不對外公開 B 的介面

b.zh-Hant: B 的 private 成員在 D 中變成 public

c.zh-Hant: D 可以直接存取 B 的 private 成員

d.zh-Hant: B 的 public 成員在 D 中變成 protected

explanation.zh-Hant: private 繼承把基底中 public 與 protected 的成員在衍生類別裡降為 private：D 內部仍可使用，但 D 的物件不再對外提供 B 的介面，也不構成公開的 is-a 關係。無論用哪種繼承方式，基底 private 成員都無法被衍生類別直接存取。

options.text: They become private in D, so D does not expose B's interface publicly
B's private members become public in D
D can access B's private members directly
B's public members become protected in D

questions.explanation: Private inheritance demotes public and protected base members to private in the derived class: D can still use them internally, but D's objects no longer expose B's interface, so the is-a relationship is not public. Base private members stay inaccessible either way.

questions.prompt: In `class D : public virtual B`, why is the `virtual` keyword used on the base class?

prompt.zh-Hant: `class D : public virtual B` 中的 `virtual` 有甚麼作用？

a.zh-Hant: 讓所有衍生類別共用同一個 B 基底子物件

b.zh-Hant: 讓 B 的解構函式自動變成 virtual

c.zh-Hant: 讓 B 的所有成員函式都變成 virtual

d.zh-Hant: 禁止其他類別再繼承 B

explanation.zh-Hant: 虛擬基底讓最衍生類別只保留一份 B 子物件。在菱形繼承中，若兩條路徑都非虛擬地繼承 B，D 會含有兩份 B，造成成員存取不明確；改用 virtual 繼承即可合併成一份。它不會讓成員函式或解構函式自動變成 virtual。

options.text: So that all derived classes share a single B base subobject
So that B's destructor automatically becomes virtual
So that every member function of B becomes virtual
To forbid any further class from deriving from B

questions.explanation: A virtual base is stored once and shared by every class in the hierarchy. In a diamond, non-virtual inheritance of the same base through two paths gives D two B subobjects and makes member access ambiguous; virtual inheritance merges them. It does not make member functions or the destructor virtual.

questions.prompt: Which statements about inheritance access control are correct? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列關於繼承存取控制的敘述，哪些正確？可多選。

a.zh-Hant: 使用 public 繼承時，基底的 public 成員在衍生類別中仍是 public。

b.zh-Hant: protected 基底成員可在衍生類別的成員函式中使用，但無法透過無關的物件存取。

c.zh-Hant: 衍生類別可以直接存取基底的 private 成員。

d.zh-Hant: 使用 private 繼承時，基底的 public 成員在衍生類別中變成 private。

explanation.zh-Hant: public 繼承保留 public 成員的可見性；protected 只開放給衍生類別與其成員函式，外界仍不可及；private 繼承把 public 與 protected 成員降為 private。基底的 private 成員永遠只有基底本身（及其 friend）能存取。

options.text: With public inheritance, public base members stay public in the derived class.
A protected base member is usable inside derived member functions but not through an unrelated object.
A derived class can access the private members of its base class directly.
With private inheritance, public base members become private in the derived class.

questions.explanation: Public inheritance keeps public members public; protected members are reachable only inside the derived class and its member functions; private inheritance demotes public and protected base members to private. Base private members remain accessible only to the base class itself and its friends.

questions.prompt: Which statements about multiple inheritance and virtual bases are correct? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列關於多重繼承與虛擬基底的敘述，哪些正確？可多選。

a.zh-Hant: 虛擬基底由最衍生的類別負責初始化，中間類別的初始化會被忽略。

b.zh-Hant: 虛擬繼承可以消除菱形階層中重複的基底子物件。

c.zh-Hant: 一個 C++ 類別可以同時繼承多個基底類別。

d.zh-Hant: 虛擬基底類別不能擁有建構函式。

explanation.zh-Hant: 虛擬基底只有一份，因此由最衍生類別直接初始化，中間類別寫在初始化列表中的虛擬基底初始化會被忽略；虛擬繼承正是為了解決菱形重複子物件；C++ 支援多重繼承。虛擬基底當然可以有建構函式。

options.text: A virtual base is initialized by the most-derived class, and intermediate initializers for it are ignored.
Virtual inheritance removes duplicate base subobjects in a diamond hierarchy.
A C++ class may inherit from more than one base class.
A virtual base class cannot have constructors.

questions.explanation: Because only one virtual base subobject exists, the most-derived class initializes it and mem-initializers for it in intermediate classes are ignored. Virtual inheritance merges the duplicated base in a diamond, and multiple inheritance itself is a standard C++ feature. Virtual bases may of course have constructors.

questions.prompt: A derived class constructor can directly initialize the private data members of its base class in its member initializer list.

prompt.zh-Hant: 衍生類別的建構函式可以在成員初始化列表中，直接初始化基底類別的 private 資料成員。

explanation.zh-Hant: private 成員只有基底類別本身（及其 friend）能存取。衍生類別應改為呼叫基底的建構函式，把參數交給基底去初始化。

questions.explanation: Private members are accessible only to the base class itself and its friends. A derived constructor must call a base constructor and let the base initialize its own data.

questions.prompt: If a derived class declares a function with the same name as a base-class function, a `using Base::name;` declaration can bring the base overloads back into the derived class scope.

prompt.zh-Hant: 若衍生類別宣告了與基底同名的函式，可用 `using Base::name;` 把基底的各個多載重新引入衍生類別的作用域。

explanation.zh-Hant: 衍生類別的同名宣告會遮蔽整個基底名稱，包含其他多載；`using Base::name;` 把基底版本帶回同一作用域，讓多載解析能同時看到兩邊。

questions.explanation: A derived declaration hides every base overload with that name. A using-declaration reintroduces the base versions into the derived scope so overload resolution sees both sets.

questions.prompt: When a derived class declares a function with the same name as a non-virtual base function, the base function is ____ in the derived class.

prompt.zh-Hant: 當衍生類別宣告了與非 virtual 基底函式同名的函式時，該基底函式在衍生類別中被 ____。

explanation.zh-Hant: 名稱查找會先在衍生類別找到該名稱就停止，因此基底版本被「隱藏」（name hiding），即使簽章不同也一樣；要用 `Base::f()` 或 using 宣告才呼叫得到。

questions.explanation: Name lookup stops as soon as it finds the name in the derived class, so the base version is hidden even when the signatures differ. A qualified call such as `Base::f()` or a using-declaration is needed to reach it.

questions.prompt: In two or three sentences, explain the difference between overriding a virtual function and hiding a base-class function.

prompt.zh-Hant: 用兩至三句說明「覆寫 virtual 函式」與「隱藏基底函式」的分別。

model.zh-Hant: 覆寫要求基底函式是 virtual 且簽章完全相同，透過基底指標或參考呼叫時，會在執行期依物件實際型別決定呼叫哪個版本。隱藏則是衍生類別宣告了同名但簽章不同的函式，或基底函式不是 virtual：名稱查找在衍生類別就停止，必須用限定呼叫或 using 宣告才碰得到基底版本。覆寫是動態綁定，隱藏只是編譯期的名稱查找規則。

explanation.zh-Hant: 關鍵在於「簽章是否相同、基底是否 virtual」以及「綁定發生在編譯期還是執行期」。

answer.model: Overriding requires a virtual base function and an identical signature; the derived version is chosen at run time through a base pointer or reference. Hiding happens when the derived class declares a same-named function with a different signature, or when the base function is not virtual: name lookup stops in the derived scope, so the base version is reachable only with a qualified call or a using-declaration. Overriding is dynamic dispatch, while hiding is a compile-time name-lookup rule.

questions.explanation: The deciding factors are whether the signature matches and the base function is virtual, and whether binding happens at compile time or at run time.
